1.name: Rustling Grass
1.desc: A Pokémon is trapped in the tall grass.
1.choice3After: You have no time to get involved.

2.name: Pokémon's Thanks
2.desc: To thank you, the Pokémon brings you a reward.

3.name: The Hunter's Revenge
3.choice2After: You trip while fleeing and scrape your head, but he doesn't catch up.
3.desc: You stole the hunter's dinner; now he demands a duel.

11.name: End of the Road
11.desc: Ready to head to the next region?

12.name: Masters Division
12.desc: You've reached the Masters arena entrance. Trainer, are you ready? (Entering the Masters counts as clearing the run and settles related clear achievements.)

15.name: Ready to Go
15.desc: What should you bring on the adventure?

21.name: Pitch-Black Cave
21.choice1After: You find something useful in the cave.
21.choiceDesc1: Go inside (requires a Fire-type Pokémon on your team)
21.desc: Something seems to be in the cave, but it's pitch black inside.

22.name: Empty Belly
22.choice2After: Eating it raw, your stomach hurts the whole way.
22.choiceDesc1: Cook it (requires a Fire-type Pokémon on your team)
22.desc: Your stomach won't stop growling, so you catch a few fish in the river.

23.name: Fallen Tree
23.choice2After: You accidentally start a forest fire and get a harsh fine from the rangers.
23.choiceDesc2: Burn it (requires a Fire-type Pokémon on your team)
23.choiceDesc1: Move it (requires a Fighting-type Pokémon on your team)
23.desc: A huge tree trunk blocks the road.

24.name: The Cliff
24.choiceDesc2: Fly to the far side (requires a Flying-type Pokémon on your team)
24.choice1After: Below the cliff is a narrow path that seems to lead somewhere.
24.choiceDesc1: Climb down with vines (requires a Grass-type Pokémon on your team)
24.desc: A steep cliff lies ahead; there's no way forward.

25.name: Forest Dwellers
25.choiceDesc2: Looks like a battle can't be avoided
25.choiceDesc1: Send Pokémon to talk (requires a Grass-type Pokémon on your team)
25.desc: The forest Pokémon seem hostile to outsiders.
25.choice3After: The residents thank you, heal you, and give you plenty of gold.

26.name: Firefly Woods
26.choiceDesc2: Picnic (requires a Lunch Box in hand)

27.name: Rogue Hideout
27.choice1After: While they sleep, you grab a few things.
27.choiceDesc1: Blend in (requires a Dark-type Pokémon on your team)

28.name: The Arena
28.choice2After: The brawl is so rough you get caught in the crossfire.
28.choiceDesc1: Join the challenge (requires a Fighting-type Pokémon on your team)
28.desc: Shouts echo nearby—a fierce fighting tournament seems to be underway.

29.name: Ancient Tomb
29.choiceDesc1: Speak with the spirits (requires a Ghost-type Pokémon on your team)
29.desc: An old tomb full of drifting spirits—they don't seem to like being disturbed.

30.name: Rampaging Pokémon
30.choiceDesc2: Break the mind control (requires a Psychic-type Pokémon on your team)

31.name: Potion Seller
31.desc: I've got some curious potions for sale—try my new brew and I won't charge you.

32.name: Lost
32.choiceDesc2: Go where the growth rings are tight
32.choice1After: You find your way out of the forest.
32.choiceDesc1: Go where the growth rings are sparse
32.desc: You're lost in the woods. The map says the exit is south—which way do you go?

33.name: Theft
33.choice1After: You trip chasing them, but you recover all your money.
33.desc: A shadowy figure stole your money.

34.name: Strange Egg
34.desc: A strange egg sits in the grass.

35.name: Professor's Lab
35.choice1After: The Professor thanks you and funds your journey.
35.choiceDesc1: Ask the Professor to study it (requires a Strange Egg in hand)
35.desc: You arrive at the Professor's research lab.

101.name: Rustling Grass
101.desc: A Pokémon is trapped in the tall grass.

102.name: Gratitude
102.choiceDesc3: It wants to adventure with you
102.choiceDesc2: It gives you a bundle of herbs
102.choiceDesc1: It gives you a strange item
102.desc: You meet the Pokémon you rescued before.

103.name: The Hunter's Revenge
103.choice2After: You hurt yourself scrambling to escape.
103.desc: You stole the hunter's dinner; now he demands a duel.

201.name: Delivery Box
201.choiceDesc2: Open it and see what's inside
201.choiceDesc1: Pick it up for Professor Oak
201.desc: A black parcel lies by the road. The label reads: "To Professor Oak."

202.name: Professor's House
202.choice1After: The Professor thanks you and funds your journey.
202.desc: You arrive at the Professor's research lab.

301.name: Bank
301.desc: Depositing money can earn you more later.
